source.candidate: trusted MCTS transitions with ordered peg insertion, derived occupancy reuse, and allocation-free shared-endpoint crossing checks

canonical_throughput.method: Two adjacent unprofiled runs per implementation on the same host; arithmetic means summarize the recorded runs. The baseline is dev/v0.0.6 after the retained expansion and metadata work.

equivalence.golden_test: The seeded 5x5 sparse-policy search retains the complete serialized move and metadata SHA-256; exhaustive crossing geometry and canonical state/transition tests retain automatic-link, ordering, legality, win, and immutability semantics.

transition_microbenchmark.method: Nine samples of 3000 repetitions over four deterministic 10x10 transitions at plies 10, 25, 40, and 55; the seeded fixtures are built once outside the timed samples, with PYTHONHASHSEED=0, on CPU. Times are divided by 12000 transitions per sample. The in-process reference reproduces the replaced validated transition, neighbor discovery, shared-endpoint set intersection, tuple sorting, and occupied-set reconstruction.

rejected_approaches.implementation: mutate one board/state object in place during MCTS and roll moves back after each simulation
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: Policy/value and rollout hooks receive GameState values, so exposing a mutable search state would violate canonical immutability and could let retained callback references change after evaluation.

rejected_approaches.implementation: append pegs and links without canonical insertion or sorting
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: Construction order would replace the public canonical peg/link order, changing serialization, encoding traversal, persisted artifacts, and potentially seeded decisions.

rejected_approaches.implementation: skip automatic-link crossing checks or trust links without constructing validated Link values
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: Either shortcut weakens the authoritative automatic-link and crossing rules. The retained fast path skips only move revalidation after MCTS selects a placement from the same immutable state's legal list.

rejected_approaches.implementation: make the public apply_move path assume legal placements
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: Public callers must retain deterministic legality precedence and IllegalMoveError reasons. Only the private MCTS path uses the already-legal transition entry point.
